description: SharePoint list items (CT-D-08): an item stating a receipt's document date is an ExpenseReceipt and an item stating an invoice date (and no document date) is a VendorInvoiceEntry, each with its columns typed; every other item stays the generated SharePointListItem (its fields blob). Every list item's text values are mention documents of its own type (ontology/schema.py SHAREPOINT_LIST_MENTION_LINK_RULES). One rule over the item's own columns, never a list named in code.

object_types.description: A SharePoint list item that records an expense receipt: it states the receipt's document date, and with it the vendor, the amount and its currency, the category, the status and, on some lists, who paid (the expense lists captured today). Typed from the list item's own columns as written, cited to the item; the whole record is finance and personal data (personal expenses, transfers to named people), visible only to readers of the list who hold both markings. Its words reach search through the record text of the item (operating/chunking). Lists of vendor invoices (InvoiceId, InvoiceDate) state no DocDate and are VendorInvoiceEntry. Its text values keep their mention links (ExpenseReceipt.mentions_<type>).

marking_rules.why: an expense list item is one person's spending (categories such as personal, e-transfers to named people): finance and personal data on the whole record, not only the amount

evidence.note: The capture whose rows this binding reads (listItems with expand=fields).

bindings.note: One object per captured list item that states a receipt's document date (fields.DocDate present: the expense lists). rest_to_generated: every other item is a VendorInvoiceEntry (it states InvoiceDate) or stays the generated SharePointListItem (its binding takes fields.DocDate absent), so one record is one object.

object_types.description: A SharePoint list item that records a vendor invoice: it states the invoice date (InvoiceDate), and with it the vendor, the invoice number, the amount in its stated currency, its Canadian-dollar amount with the rate and rate source used, the month it is filed under and a link to the invoice file (the vendor-invoice lists captured since 11-13); the commissions-owing list adds its pre-tax, HST, interest and total-owing amounts. Typed from the item's own columns as written, cited to the item; the whole record is finance data, visible only to readers of the list who hold the marking, and the address it was mailed from is personal data. An item that states a receipt's document date (DocDate) is an ExpenseReceipt instead, never both. Its text values keep their mention links (VendorInvoiceEntry.mentions_<type>), and its invoice number is a vendor invoice number another record's mention can reach.

marking_rules.why: a vendor invoice list item is the company's spending with a vendor (amounts, rates, invoice files): finance data on the whole record, not only the amounts

evidence.note: The capture whose rows this binding reads (listItems with expand=fields).

bindings.note: One object per captured list item that states an invoice date and no receipt document date (fields.InvoiceDate present, fields.DocDate absent: the vendor-invoice lists). rest_to_generated: an item stating neither stays the generated SharePointListItem (its binding takes fields.DocDate and fields.InvoiceDate absent), so one record is one object.
